title: WIMAGINE · executed and imagined reaching
citation: Pollina L, Struber L, De Seta V, Russo E, Karakas S, Chabardes S, Aksenova T, Charvet G, Shokur S, Micera S (2026). Decoupling simultaneous motor imagination and execution via orthogonal ECoG neural representations. Nature Communications. doi:10.1038/s41467-026-71234-0. NEMAR derivative nm000408 v1.0.2, doi:10.82901/nemar.nm000408.
processing: Authors applied zero-phase fifth-order Butterworth band-pass 1–250 Hz before release.
NEMAR repackaged source float64 values as float32 BrainVision without further signal processing.
This excerpt selects 8 of 32 channels and 20 seconds beginning at source sample 4681 (zero based); no resampling, re-referencing, normalization, or additional filtering.
JSON sample values rounded to six decimal places in source units.
limitations: The original release does not state physical signal units. NEMAR labels µV as an assumption; the viewer therefore labels amplitudes as source units and does not assert calibrated microvolts.
No per-contact coordinates are released. M1/S1 labels are source annotations; channel order must not be used as a physical array map.
One participant and a short illustrative excerpt; not representative of all WIMAGINE implants, sessions or outcomes.
RE-E means executed reaching and RE-I means imagined reaching. Events are task instructions from the release, not decoded predictions or measurements of movement.
Filtered continuous ECoG, not original raw implant output and not single-neuron spike signals.
